desert: You see a mirage in the distance.

pois.name: Abandoned Iron Mine
pois.description: An old stone mine entrance carved into the northern mountainside. Dark tracks lead down into the abyss.

pois.name: Ancient Ruins
pois.description: Crumbling pillars covered in glowing moss surround a cracked dais in the north.

pois.name: Highland Watchtower
pois.description: A lonely stone watchtower overlooking the northern valleys and snowy peaks.

pois.name: Sunken Desert Oasis
pois.description: A shimmering pool of emerald spring water surrounded by desert palm trees to the south.

pois.name: Mercenary Desert Fort
pois.description: Heavily fortified desert tents and palisades pitched among the scorched dunes.

pois.name: Scorpion Nest
pois.description: A treacherous cluster of hollow sandstone rocks buzzing with venomous scorpions.

pois.name: Forgotten Sunken Crypt
pois.description: An ancient stone crypt half-swallowed by the southern desert sands.

pois.name: Whispering River
pois.description: A rushing freshwater river winding through the eastern plains with an old fisherman's pier.

pois.name: Abandoned Outpost
pois.description: A ruined stone structure. It looks like it was used for observation long ago.

pois.name: Goblin's Clearing
pois.description: A suspiciously cozy clearing in the northeast forest. Something feels... off.

pois.name: Bandit Stronghold
pois.description: A wooden fortress occupied by ruthless highwaymen overlooking the eastern road.

pois.name: Mystic Moonlit Shrine
pois.description: An ancient glowing altar humming with dormant arcane power in the western forest.

pois.name: Witch's Hollow
pois.description: A foggy northwestern grove where rare blue and red medicinal herbs grow in abundance.

pois.name: Overgrown Crypt
pois.description: A moss-covered stone mausoleum exhaling a chilly, unnatural draft.

pois.name: Crystal Spring
pois.description: A secluded spring bubbling with pure, refreshing mineral water to the southwest.

pois.name: Hermit's Shelter
pois.description: A hidden cavern shelter tucked behind thorny desert brambles.

cave_entrance.description_suffix: You see a dark opening leading down.
